title: Explorer section tabs
responsibility: Renders a selectable horizontal strip of explorer sections.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.onview
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the chosen section after a plain link click or enabled button click.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.tabs
inputs.description: Optional tab definitions. When omitted, uses map, compare, history, growth and activity; an explicitly empty list renders no tabs. Definitions may provide destinations and disabled state.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible navigation label, defaulting to Views.

outputs.name: HarnessTabs
outputs.description: Links for enabled tabs with destinations and buttons otherwise. Keeps the selected tab visible within the scrolling strip as selection or size changes, without moving focus or scrolling the page.
